desc_en: Exhibition curated by 0xfff that opened on Ethereum mainnet on 12 November 2024 and exists only as a smart contract pointing to seven contract artworks, with an introductory essay by Malte Rauch; it has no closing date.
desc_zh: 由 0xfff 策划、2024 年 11 月 12 日在以太坊主网开幕的展览，仅以一个指向七件合约作品的智能合约形式存在，附 Malte Rauch 的导言文章；展览没有闭幕日期。
